correctness.rationale: The operator-norm analytic proof in RESULT.md, Steps 1–4, checks. Normalized monomials give the displayed Laplace-moment matrix. The norm of each rank-one kernel element is the product of its vector and functional norms. The three boundary regimes for the squared output norm give kernel singularity powers -1+delta/2 and -1-alpha/2, with a square-root log multiplier at beta=2; h is strictly inside the available margin. The rank-one trace-class norm equals the operator norm, so the real integral converges. The chosen disks give Cauchy radius twice the panel half-length, positive Gauss weights integrate the Taylor polynomial exactly, and the error per panel is O(2^(-m-hj)). The positive-h tail, rank count, and the approximation-number characterization then give all claimed singular-value and Schatten consequences. The displayed analytical proof suffices; frozen numerical code inspected, not executed, and finite truncations would not certify the rate. Proof replay: RESULT.md lines 35–99.
